lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical line structures are visible. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-torso, with increased density and narrower intervals observed at the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 3rd and 4th vertical lines (counting from the shoulder), where they converge into a single origin point along the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line terminates abruptly at mid-lateral torso height. The 10th and 11th posterior lines are discontinuous, consisting of vertical chains of discrete elliptical spots rather than solid lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior haunch, centered between the mid-flank and the upper hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment is observed between two spots on the upper hind limb and the ventral-most spots of the 10th vertical torso column.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark dorsal ridge line; white chevron marking on the bridge of the muzzle; high-contrast black fur on the terminal third of the tail; dark 'sock' markings on the distal limbs.
